row.body: A fresh battery is taped to a field radio. Green spray flecks fill the speaker grille, and the last tuning mark is below the county warning channel.
row.title: Field radio with a fresh battery

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

row.body: A radio sits beside a loose battery. A pencil mark on the dial matches one on the workbench; every other frequency has been scratched away.
row.title: A receiver with a single mark

sidecar.gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
